text.headline: Captain America on Screen
text.text:
Story order (in-universe)

Every Captain America film, plus the Avengers team-ups and the Disney+ series that carry the story from Steve Rogers to Sam Wilson.

Use the buttons above to switch between release order and story order (when each one takes place in the MCU).

media.credit: Poster © Marvel Studios / Disney, via Wikipedia
media.alt: Poster for Captain America: The First Avenger

text.headline: Captain America: The First Avenger
text.text:
Frail Brooklyn volunteer Steve Rogers (Chris Evans) is transformed by the Super Soldier Serum and becomes Captain America, leading the fight against HYDRA and the Red Skull during World War II.

His sacrifice at the end of the war leaves him frozen in the Arctic ice for nearly seventy years — and his best friend, Bucky Barnes, presumed dead.

Read more on Wikipedia

media.credit: Poster © Marvel Studios / Disney, via Wikipedia
media.alt: Poster for Captain America: The First Avenger showing Steve Rogers holding his shield

text.headline: The Avengers
text.text:
A man out of time, Steve is recruited by Nick Fury to lead Earth's Mightiest Heroes against Loki's invasion of New York — and learns to work alongside Tony Stark.

Read more on Wikipedia

media.credit: Poster © Marvel Studios / Disney, via Wikipedia
media.alt: Poster for The Avengers showing the six original Avengers

text.headline: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
text.text:
Steve discovers HYDRA has been hiding inside S.H.I.E.L.D. since the war. With Black Widow and new ally Sam Wilson (Anthony Mackie) as the Falcon, he faces a deadly assassin: a brainwashed Bucky Barnes, the Winter Soldier.

Read more on Wikipedia

media.credit: Poster © Marvel Studios / Disney, via Wikipedia
media.alt: Poster for Captain America: The Winter Soldier showing Captain America with his shield

text.headline: Avengers: Age of Ultron
text.text:
The Avengers fight Ultron, a rogue AI built by Tony Stark. The destruction of Sokovia sets up the political fallout that will split the team.

Read more on Wikipedia

media.credit: Poster © Marvel Studios / Disney, via Wikipedia
media.alt: Poster for Avengers: Age of Ultron showing the Avengers facing Ultron

text.headline: Captain America: Civil War
text.text:
The Sokovia Accords would put the Avengers under United Nations oversight. Steve refuses to sign, sides with Bucky, and goes to war with Tony Stark — leaving the Avengers broken apart.

Read more on Wikipedia

media.credit: Poster © Marvel Studios / Disney, via Wikipedia
media.alt: Poster for Captain America: Civil War showing Captain America and Iron Man on opposing sides

text.headline: Avengers: Infinity War
text.text:
A bearded, fugitive Steve returns to defend Wakanda against Thanos. The heroes lose: Thanos's snap wipes out half of all life, Bucky and Sam included.

Read more on Wikipedia

media.credit: Poster © Marvel Studios / Disney, via Wikipedia
media.alt: Poster for Avengers: Infinity War showing Thanos above the heroes

text.headline: Avengers: Endgame
text.text:
Steve finally lifts Mjolnir, leads the final battle, then stays in the past to live a life with Peggy Carter. As an old man he passes the shield to Sam Wilson.

Read more on Wikipedia

events.display_date: Set in 2023, five years after the Snap · released 2019

media.credit: Poster © Marvel Studios / Disney, via Wikipedia
media.alt: Poster for Avengers: Endgame showing the surviving Avengers

text.headline: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
text.text:
A six-episode Disney+ series. Unsure he deserves the shield, Sam gives it to the Smithsonian — only for the government to hand it to John Walker as a new Captain America. Teaming up with Bucky, Sam learns the legacy of Isaiah Bradley and finally takes up the mantle himself.

Read more on Wikipedia

media.credit: Poster © Marvel Studios / Disney, via Wikipedia
media.alt: Title logo for The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

text.headline: Captain America: Brave New World
text.text:
The first Captain America film without Steve Rogers. Sam Wilson is now Captain America, with Joaquín Torres (Danny Ramirez) as the new Falcon, and he is pulled into a conspiracy around President Thaddeus Ross (Harrison Ford).

Read more on Wikipedia

media.credit: Poster © Marvel Studios / Disney, via Wikipedia
media.alt: Poster for Captain America: Brave New World showing Sam Wilson as Captain America

text.headline: Thunderbolts*
text.text:
Bucky Barnes, now a congressman, and John Walker (U.S. Agent) join a team of antiheroes — a look at what happened to the people who once stood beside, or in place of, Captain America.

Read more on Wikipedia
